parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with printed maps.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information such as countries, oceans, and continents. It can rotate around its axis for educational and demonstrative purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the supporting axis attached to the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base and supporting arm of the globe, made of plastic, providing stability and support for the rotating sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the globe in place and allows the sphere to rotate smoothly while maintaining balance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a pivot axis for the sphere’s rotation.
